datasets: new RGB mask observation if produced
heldout: Existing synthetic Check and recorded MAPPO Holdout RGB excluded from fit and fusion. New captures must define withheld frames/views before scoring.
correspondence: RGB-only observed pixels are recorded independently from source truth. Bind an observed pixel to the estimated triangle/barycentric point and reproject that same point. Missing/failed tracking remains in the denominator. Post-fit nearest source-surface candidates do not count as correspondences.
truth_isolation: Freeze input hashes, source, parameters and reconstruction/texture artifacts before independent evaluator opens truth. Solver uses healthy template, calibrated original RGB and RGB-derived masks only.
unknown: No fill or success substitution for missing observations; atlas alpha=0 stays unknown.
stage4: DEFERRED: no texture-feature geometric objective; no crack depth, dent or bulge research
classification: Synthetic ideal observations, recorded MAPPO Blender, and field observations reported separately; no field data exists.
